DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with Venous Stasis Ulcer.

The combination of your 10-year history of chronic swelling, family history of similar issues, prior DVT, and a large wound on the lower leg is classic for venous stasis. Given the duration and likely severity, have you noticed any pain when elevating your leg or any signs of infection like redness or fever?
